1.0.0
=============

* New features:
   * [#162869](https://ewave.tpondemand.com/entity/162869) -- Pre-Order. Solution Architecture
   * [#162870](https://ewave.tpondemand.com/entity/162870) -- GENERAL SETTINGS. As an admin, I want to be able turn on the pre-order for the storeview
   * [#162871](https://ewave.tpondemand.com/entity/162871) -- ORDER DETAILS. As an admin, I want to see pre-order product on the order detail page and orders on the order grid marked with "Pre-order" label
   * [#162872](https://ewave.tpondemand.com/entity/162872) -- PRODUCT SETTINGS. As admin, I want to be able to allow pre-order for products (simple / configurable / group / bundle)
   * [#162873](https://ewave.tpondemand.com/entity/162873) -- PRODUCT LISTING. As a user, I want to be able to pre-order product on the product listing page
   * [#162874](https://ewave.tpondemand.com/entity/162874) -- PRODUCT DETAIL. As a user, I want to be able to pre-order product on the product detail page
   * [#162875](https://ewave.tpondemand.com/entity/162875) -- CART. As a user,I want to see a message next to pre-order products in cart
   * [#176940](https://ewave.tpondemand.com/entity/176940) -- PRODUCT WIDGET. As a user, I want to see "pre-order" Label for pre-order products on the product catalog widget
   * [#159236](https://ewave.tpondemand.com/entity/159236) -- As a system, I want the architectire and the code of the extension to be validated (see description)

=============
* Bugfixes:

    * [#268614](https://ewave.tpondemand.com/entity/268614) -- [DISPLAY ALL METHODS] Exception for virtual product
